questions.stem: Select all matrix cell types present in Loose Areolar Connective Tissue: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Areolar CT contains fibroblasts, mast cells, histocytes, plasma cells.

questions.stem: Select all Granulocytic Leucocytes found in human blood: (Select all that apply)
Which locations feature Pseudostratified Ciliated Columnar Epithelium? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Pseudostratified ciliated columnar lines trachea, bronchi, nasopharynx.

questions.stem: Select all connective tissue sheaths organizing skeletal muscle blocks: (Select all that apply)
Which structures contain Bipolar Neurones? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Bipolar neurones occur in retina, olfactory mucosa, vestibular organ.

questions.stem: Select all features characteristic of Smooth Muscle tissue: (Select all that apply)
options: B) Single central nucleus per cell
answers: B) Single central nucleus per cell
questions.explanation: Smooth muscle cells are spindle-shaped, uninucleated, involuntary, and unstriated.

questions.stem: Select all structural elements forming a Compact Bone Osteon (Haversian System): (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Osteons consist of Haversian canals, concentric lamellae, lacunae with osteocytes, and canaliculi.

questions.stem: Select all functions performed by Blood Plasma proteins: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Colloid osmotic pressure maintenance by Albumin
B) Humoral immune defense by Gamma Globulins
C) Blood clotting cascade by Fibrinogen
answers: A) Colloid osmotic pressure maintenance by Albumin
B) Humoral immune defense by Gamma Globulins
C) Blood clotting cascade by Fibrinogen
questions.explanation: Plasma proteins (Albumin, Globulin, Fibrinogen) maintain osmotic pressure, immunity, and clotting. Hemoglobin is inside RBCs.

questions.stem: Which cell types in connective tissue release inflammatory mediators during allergic responses? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Mast cells, Basophils, and Eosinophils mediate allergic and inflammatory responses.

questions.stem: Select all anatomical locations containing Yellow Elastic Cartilage: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Elastic cartilage forms ear pinna, epiglottis, Eustachian tube, and nasal tip.
